edits.before: W-diving into held CC — the lock-on telegraphs, the dogs can't dodge, and the lane's one button answers everything.
edits.after: The Satchel knocks him away unharmed and you through the minefield — commit only after that one escape is spent.

edits.before: Trade behind the screen and bleed the contacts — your early strings out-stat most of the lane's expectations.
edits.after: Trade behind minions — his Short Fuse auto-reset wind-up is the poke tell; step back on it, step forward on his Q whiff.

edits.before: Ziggs wins by landing Satchel Charge, denying your pattern, and renting you the lane at a range markup.
edits.after: Ziggs wins by mining the wave, satcheling out of every dive, and turning the lane into 850-range poke you never touch.

edits.before: You are the flank with a head count: R the approach, W through the front line, and let the hounds peel-proof the exit.
edits.after: Late he sieges but stays helpless in melee — flank around the minefield with R speed and reach him before the Satchel.
